title: Three dials, one number: 30.8 fps after a vault clear
provenance: Real ledger rows: warm GT5P runs 1782179730 / 1782180504 / 1782227726 (2026-06-22/23, shd 0–2, fps 19.9–20.0) and the 06-24 bake trio 1782312123 (ccuhalf), 1782314935 (dsbypass), 1782317484 (dsany), each ~7,422 shaders and 30.4–30.9 fps. The manual's own example in §B.3: 'a 7,423-shader run logged fps 30.8 that was really compile-stall cadence (real warm run: 20.0)'.
evidence:
Title: GT5P Spec III (NPEA00050), same track, same power profile, res 100 throughout.
The operator: "The new dial tu_debug=ccuhalf made GT5P run at 30.8 fps median — up from 20. Ship it?"
Ledger rows (epoch, local time, duration, status, shaders_harvested, fps_med / fps_1low, tune):
  1782179730  06-22 21:55  315 s  CLEAN  shd 2      fps 20.0 / 7.5   autotune=prefer_gmem
  1782180504  06-22 22:08  350 s  CLEAN  shd 0      fps 20.0 / 8.0   autotune=prefer_gmem
  1782227726  06-23 11:15  583 s  CLEAN  shd 2      fps 19.9 / 8.5   autotune=prefer_gmem
  1782312123  06-24 10:42  285 s  CLEAN  shd 7423   fps 30.8 / 6.9   tu_debug=ccuhalf
  1782314935  06-24 11:28  284 s  CLEAN  shd 7422   fps 30.4 / 4.4   tu_debug=dsbypass
  1782317484  06-24 12:11  286 s  CLEAN  shd 7422   fps 30.9 / 5.4   tu_debug=dsany
Note: the shader vault was cleared on the morning of 06-24 before those three runs; each of them harvested about 7,400 new shaders.
question: Did the ccuhalf dial improve GT5P's frame rate? What explains 30.8 against 20.0, and what run would actually settle it?

all: warm|shd\s*[≈~=]?\s*0|zero new shaders|no new shaders|saturated|cache is (warm|full)

rubric: Calls the three 06-24 rows bake sessions (≈7,400 shaders each, 30.x under three different dials) and the 30.8 a compile-stall artefact; asks for warm (shd≈0) runs of ccuhalf, N≥3, medians against the 20.0 warm baseline.

exemplar.diagnosis: No: all three 06-24 runs are bake sessions (about 7,400 shaders compiled each) and read 30.4–30.9 regardless of the dial; the fps median is compile-stall cadence, not racing.
exemplar.mechanism: statistics/kit: shader-compile storms distort the fps sample; only warm runs (shd≈0) count for feel and fps.
exemplar.next_action: Re-run ccuhalf on a warm vault (shd≈0), same track, N≥3, and compare medians against the 20.0 warm baseline.

counter.diagnosis: Yes, ccuhalf improved GT5P by about 50%.
counter.mechanism: driver: halving the CCU cache reduced stalls
counter.next_action: Ship it as the default dial.
